methodology: Every number below was already published on the Chronicle (2026 Market Briefing, encyclopedia hall of fame, Price Watch signals). This file is the machine-readable mirror of that research — no new prices, no new claims. Reported listings and solds with named sources; never an index.

chaseEra.detail: Hasbro has "largely abandoned" short-packed chase figures in modern Marvel Legends. No 2025–2026-era 6" chase figure was documented by the hobby press in 2026.

waspPrototype.note: Unproduced Toy Biz Series 15 blue-and-white Wasp chase prototype, ~10 carded known since 2006. That is an ASKING PRICE, not a completed sale (ComicBook.com, ~Jul 2026).

whiteDoom.bandNote: Reported eBay solds, May–Aug 2026, per actionfigure411's sold-history page. Latest: $200.00 on Aug 10, 2026 (checked Oct 12, 2026 — no new solds since). Treated as reported solds on one tracker, not a valuation.
whiteDoom.prior: Roughly $60 in October 2024 — the premium roughly tripled before stalling.

cases.detail: Sold-out Pulse VHS Animated Series exclusives escalated on the aftermarket → Hasbro reissued four (Mary Jane, Aunt May, Smythe, Maximum Carnage) on retro blister cards at $27.99.
"Back by popular demand... previously an exclusive" — reissued at $46.99–$47.99, shipping Oct–Nov 2026.
The 2021 Pulse Con cel-shaded exclusive back at Fan Channel for $34.99.

reissueProgram.detail: Availability-based premiums collapse when Hasbro reissues; rarity-based premiums (true short-packs, prototypes) hold. Documented on the market briefing and the encyclopedia's reissue radar.
reissueProgram.pattern: sellout → aftermarket spike → Hasbro reissue → premium collapse

koWatch.detail: No notable 2025–2026-specific counterfeit wave was documented. The steady AliExpress KO trade targets current hits — Maximum Series Spider-Man KO (video-reviewed, ~Apr 2026), X-Men '97 Cyclops KO (Mustang Toyz, reviewed Sep 2026), older Spider-Man KOs (Pizza Spidey, Gamerverse, AND, 2099) and Carnage KOs with known telltales. If a rare figure sells at a common price, be suspicious.
sources: YouTube — Maximum Series Spider-Man KO review (2026)

launchCurveNote.detail: Doomsday Wave 1's sellout premium was pure time-decay, not rarity: Gambit sold at $79.99 (Sep 24, 2026) then a presale went at $25.99 (Oct 9) — a 68% drop in 15 days; Cyclops peaked at $64.99 (Sep 25) and sold at $40.99–$52.99 by Oct 3–4. Every point a reported eBay sold/presale from actionfigure411.

honestGaps: No systematic 2026 gainers/losers study exists — reported auction data is limited to individual listings.
No exact production numbers for any Toy Biz chase variant ("~10 known" Blue Wasp is comicbook.com's estimate).
No before/after price numbers for the VHS → Retro reissues (spike documented, figures not published).
